title: Checks for lines that exceed the specified maximum character length.
summary: Overlong lines can hurt readability. PEP 8, for example, recommends limiting lines to 79 characters. By default, this rule enforces a limit of 88 characters for compatibility with Black and the Ruff formatter, though that limit is configurable via the line-length setting. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle and made it stable in v0.0.18.

title: Checks for redundant backslashes between brackets.
summary: Explicit line joins using a backslash are redundant between brackets. Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle. It is in preview.
